title: Isolation of tumor-resident CD8+ T cells from human lung tumors
protocol: Decontaminate working spaces under the hood and equipment (scissors and tweezers) with 70% ethyl alcohol before beginning.
Prepare enzyme digestion mix in a 15 mL tube: Add 4.7 mL of RPMI medium without serum and any other supplements.
Add 200 μL of enzyme H, 100 μL of enzyme R, and 25 μL of enzyme A into the tube.
Mix well by vortexing.
Cut the tumor into small pieces of approximately 2 mm³ and place it directly into the enzyme mix.
Place the sample into a 37°C incubator under continuous rotation for 40 minutes.
Place a 100 μm cell strainer on a 50 mL tube and rinse the cell strainer with 1 mL of culture medium.
Transfer digested tumor pieces onto the cell strainer with the enzyme digestion medium.
Smash the tumor gently with the flat end of a 1 mL syringe plunger (remove the plunger from the syringe).
Regularly wash the cell strainer with culture medium during smashing of the tumor.
Smash until the maximum of tumor tissue is dissociated.
Wash the cell strainer until reaching 48 mL of cell suspension volume in the 50 mL tube.
Centrifuge the cell suspension for 10 min at 400–500 × g.
Prepare 5 mL of Red Blood Cell (RBC) lysis solution 1× during centrifugation.
Discard the supernatant and keep around 500 μL of medium in the tube.
Dissociate gently the pellet by tapping the tube.
Resuspend slowly the pellet with 5 mL of RBC lysis solution using a 5 mL pipette, making up and down movements five times.
Incubate for 3 min at 20°C–25°C.
Centrifuge the cell suspension for 5 min at 400–500 × g.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 20 mL of culture medium.
Count the number of cells and the viability with trypan blue solution.
Centrifuge the cell suspension for 5 min at 400–500 × g.
Discard the supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in 10 mL of culture medium.
Set apart around 0.5–1 million total cells for flow cytometry staining in a 5 mL tube.
Centrifuge the cell suspension for 5 min at 400–500 × g.
Discard the supernatant.
Proceed to column cell isolation.
Plate cells in a 6-well cell culture plate at 2 million/mL in rIL2 culture medium.
Place cells in a 37°C incubator.
Freeze cells in freezing media at 10–20 million cells/mL.
Centrifuge the cell suspension for 5 min at 400–500 × g.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 200 μL of PBS.
Centrifuge the cell suspension for 5 min at 400–500 × g.
Discard the supernatant.
Protect cells from light with aluminum foil during the following steps.
Prepare LIVE/DEAD Fixable blue viability staining by diluting 0.1 μL of concentrated stock with 100 μL of PBS.
Resuspend the cell pellet with 100 μL of diluted LIVE/DEAD Fixable blue.
Incubate for 25 min at 20°C–25°C.
Prepare the antibody mix (see mix 1).
Add 100 μL of FACS buffer.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 400–500 × g.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet with 25 μL of Fc block solution diluted 1/10 with FACS buffer.
Incubate for 10 min at 20°C–25°C.
Add directly to the cell suspension 25 μL of antibody mix 1 (concentrated 2×).
Incubate for 25 min on ice.
Wash by adding 300 μL of FACS buffer to the tube.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 400–500 × g, then discard the supernatant.
Resuspend in 200 μL of FACS buffer and filter the cell suspension on a 50 μm cell strainer before analysis with Fortessa 488/640/405/561/355 (BD Biosciences) flow cytometer.
Resuspend total cells in cold Miltenyi buffer at a concentration of 10 × 10^6 total cells per 80 μL.
Add 20 μL of human CD8 microbeads for each 10 × 10^6 total cells and mix well using pipetting up and down.
Incubate the mixture at 4°C for 15 minutes.
Attach a magnet to the magnetic stand and place an LS column in the magnet field.
Add a 50 μm pre-separation filter to the LS column.
Equilibrate the column by adding 3 mL of cold Miltenyi buffer through the filter.
Wait until the reservoir is empty before proceeding.
Place a 15 mL tube under the column to collect unlabeled cells from the flow-through.
After incubation with microbeads, wash the cells by adding 5 mL of cold Miltenyi buffer.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 400–500 × g for 5 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant completely after centrifuging.
Resuspend the cells in 1 mL of cold Miltenyi buffer (or 500 μL if fewer than 10 million cells).
Apply cell suspension through the cell strainer in the LS column.
Split the volume to pass cell suspension through two cell strainers if dense or contains many dead cells.
Add 3 mL of cold Miltenyi buffer when passing cell suspension through the column.
Collect the flow-through into a 15 mL tube.
Repeat washing steps by adding 3 mL of Miltenyi buffer three times.
Remove the LS column from the magnet and place it in a new collection 15 mL tube after emptying the reservoir.
Add 5 mL of Miltenyi buffer to the LS column to recover the positive CD8+ fraction.
Flush out cells immediately by pushing the plunger into the column.
Centrifuge the cell suspension for 5 min at 400–500 × g.
Aspirate the supernatant completely after centrifuging.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 3 mL culture medium.
Count the number of cells in the positive fraction and determine viability with trypan blue solution.
Centrifuge the CD8+ cell suspension for 5 min at 400–500 × g.
Keep CD8+ cells in culture by plating them in a 96-V-well culture plate at 10,000 cells/200 μL/well and placing it in a 37°C incubator.
Freeze cells by resuspending total cells in 1 mL of freezing media and placing the tube at -80°C.
Prepare an antibody mix for up to 20 million cells (scale up accordingly).
Aspirate supernatant from CD8+ cell suspension.
Resuspend the cell pellet with the prepared antibody mix.
Incubate the resuspended cells in the dark for 20 min at 4°C.
Add 3 mL of culture medium and centrifuge the CD8+ cell suspension for 5 min at 400–500 × g.
Resuspend cells in culture medium at a concentration of approximately 10 million cells/mL.
Filter the resuspended cell suspension through a 50 μm cell strainer.
Add TO-PRO3 iodide to the filtered cell suspension at a final concentration of 0.1 μM just prior to cell sorting.
Add TO-PRO3 iodide just prior to FACS.
Prepare two 5 mL tubes containing 1 mL of culture medium for sorted cell populations.
Sort cells on a BD FACS Aria fusion 488/561/640/405/355 with an 85 μm nozzle at 4,000 events/s.
Sort desired CD8+CD103+ and CD8+KLRG1+ populations into culture medium in sterile capped tubes on ice.
Centrifuge cell suspension in a conic 15 mL tube or 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Resuspend cells in culture medium with rIL-2 (final concentration at 50 U/mL) at 0.2 to 0.5 million/mL.
Transfer resuspended cells into culture plate.
Replace culture medium every 4 or 5 days for cell amplification.
Add 2 mL PBS to the tube containing sorted cells.
Centrifuge cell suspension in a conic 15 mL tube or 1 mL Eppendorf tube for 10 min at 500 × g.
Remove completely and carefully the supernatant with a 200 μL pipette without touching the cell pellet.
Resuspend cell pellet directly in 100 μL buffer RL supplemented with 10% β-mercaptoethanol.
Mix by pipetting up and down a few times.
Proceed with RNA purification according to the manufacturer protocol.
Or keep the cell lysate at -80°C until RNA extraction.
Determine the number of cells in the CD8-negative fraction.
Centrifuge the cell suspension for 5 minutes at 400–500 × g.
Aspirate the supernatant completely.
Resuspend up to 10 million total cells in 60 μL of cold Miltenyi buffer (scale up according to cell number).
Add 20 μL of Non-tumor cell depletion Cocktail A for up to 10 million cells (scale up according to the cell number).
Add 20 μL of Non-tumor cell depletion Cocktail B for up to 10 million cells (scale up according to the cell number).
Mix well with pipetting.
Incubate for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Wait until the column reservoir is empty before proceeding to the next step.
Place the LS column in the magnet field of a Miltenyi magnet.
Add a 50 μm pre-separation filter in the LS column.
Equilibrate the LS column by pipetting 3 mL cold Miltenyi Buffer into the pre-separation filter.
Wait until the column reservoir is empty.
Place a 15 mL tube under the LS column to collect unlabeled cells.
Bring up the cell suspension to 500 μL of cold Miltenyi buffer for up to 10 million cells (scale up according to the cell number).
Apply the cell suspension through the cell strainer in the LS column.
Wait until the column reservoir is empty, then perform washing steps by adding 1 mL of Miltenyi buffer into the column.
Keep collecting the flow-through from the washing steps into the 15 mL tube containing the unlabeled cells.
Repeat step 49 once (perform another round of washing).
Optional: Remove the column from the magnet and place it into a new 15 mL tube.
Add 3 mL of Miltenyi buffer to the column, then immediately flush out the cells by pushing the plunger into the column.
Determine the cell number and viability with trypan blue solution for the untouched tumor cells.
Centrifuge the tumor cell suspension for 5 min at 400–500 × g.
Discard the supernatant completely.
Resuspend the cells in LC medium at a concentration of 200,000 tumor cells/mL.
Plate the cells in a 6/12 or 24-well culture plate as needed.
Place the plates in an incubator at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Remove the culture medium if tumor cells do not attach to the plastic after a few hours.
Wash with 2–3 mL of PBS.
Apply PBS diluted with EDTA at 1/1000.
Incubate for 2–3 min at 37°C and monitor cell detachment under a microscope.
Perform gentle pipetting with a 1 mL pipette to continue detaching adherent cells.
Stop the EDTA treatment by adding LC medium.
Transfer the cell suspension into a 15 mL tube.
Centrifuge the cell suspension.
Resuspend in the desired volume of culture medium.
